title: Tenant support-ticket runtime and OpenAPI authentication parity

phases.objective: Make every canonical tenant Support Ticket operation declare the same user JWT requirement enforced by runtime and refresh the bounded deterministic frontend evidence.

e2e_journeys.actor: authenticated tenant member and frontend contract dispatcher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The canonical OpenAPI registry composes the split Support Ticket operations under /me/support/tickets.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: All four canonical operations resolve userJwtAuth, all six mounted runtime operations remain authentication-equivalent, and the generated runtime-route index no longer duplicates those canonical paths.
steps: Compose the Support Ticket split contract into the root OpenAPI document.
Resolve runtime guards for both mounted POST and GET ticket-list operations and the ticket detail and event operations.
Compare runtime requireUserJwt with canonical userJwtAuth for every mounted operation.
Regenerate the bounded frontend dispatch and runtime-route evidence.
Remove operation-index-only Support Ticket entries now covered by the reviewed canonical contract.
assertions: Runtime and canonical authentication mismatch count is zero.
OpenAPI auth synchronization drift count is zero.
Only the two bounded generated evidence files change in addition to the reviewed split contract and this E2E contract.
No runtime authorization, database, migration, deployment, provider, credential, external-send, or protected-branch behavior changes.

phases.objective: Observe a signed-in tenant member create, list, read, and append an event to a support ticket while unauthenticated requests remain rejected.
Exercise missing, expired, and cross-tenant user JWTs without leaking ticket or resolution details.
This contract-only repair performs no live provider or deployment canary.
No runtime, database, migration, deployment, provider, credential, or direct Production mutation authority is granted.
